decisions.title: SIMOT is the canonical brain
decisions.decision: SIMOT owns orchestration, memory, planning, automation, tool routing, and business/software workflows.
decisions.reason: The interface must be replaceable and must not become a second brain.

decisions.title: Client is replaceable
decisions.decision: Phone/desktop/web clients may change without changing SIMOT state and architecture.
decisions.reason: Prevents interface problems from derailing the core project.

decisions.title: No custom mobile app for now
decisions.decision: Use an existing suitable client before building a dedicated mobile app.

decisions.title: No independent Jarvis brain
decisions.decision: Jarvis, if used, is persona/client/interface terminology, not a separate autonomous backend brain.
decisions.reason: Avoids an unnecessary extra reasoning layer.

decisions.title: Immediate write-back after verification
decisions.decision: Every meaningful task must be recorded immediately after verification, before the next task starts.
decisions.reason: Prevents context loss when a chat/session ends unexpectedly.

decisions.title: No silent scope changes
decisions.decision: A session may not change the current project/objective/architecture without explicit user approval.
decisions.reason: Direct response to repeated project drift.
